narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to engage the audience in a discussion about relationship communication styles, specifically the 'cold treatment' (silent treatment). The couple shares their differing views to offer viewers a relatable and slightly humorous perspective on how different personalities handle conflict.
